notes: Loxo Oncology acquired by Lilly for $8B to capture selpercatinib + larotrectinib (NTRK). Selpercatinib was the lead late-stage asset. EV/peak-sales ~6.7x. Deal also bought a platform (precision-oncology pipeline) so multiple understates single-asset value.
source: Lilly-Loxo merger agreement; consensus sell-side peak-sales estimates.
